Product Operations Specialist
Blinkit
Gurugram, Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)

About Blinkit:
Blinkit is India's leading quick-commerce platform delivering groceries in 10 minutes.

Responsibilities:
• Bridge communication between city warehouse operations and central product engineering.
• Investigate edge-case delivery anomalies, analyze error logs, and quantify operational bottlenecks.
• Track operational SLAs, onboarding turnaround times, and unit economics.
• Create SOPs and feature requests to automate repetitive warehouse tasks.

Requirements:
• 1-3 years of experience in product operations, bizops, or tech operations.
• Strong command of SQL, Excel, and problem-solving methodologies.
• Comfortable working in fast-paced high-growth startup environment.
• Bachelor's degree in any field.
